question: Find the surface area of a sphere whose diameter is 14 cm. (Use pi=(22)/(7))
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The surface area of a sphere in terms of its diameter (d) is directly given by πd².

⇒ Surface Area = (22 ÷ 7) × 14 × 14

⇒ Surface Area = 22 × 2 × 14 = 616 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 616 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Diameter of the sphere (d) = 14 cm

⇒ Radius (r) = d ÷ 2 = 14 ÷ 2 = 7 cm

**Formula Used:**

Surface area of a sphere = 4 × π × r²

 
 

 

 
 
• 
 r = 7 cm
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 Diameter (d) = 14 cm
 Sphere

**Calculations:**

⇒ Surface area = 4 × (22 ÷ 7) × 7²

⇒ Surface area = 4 × (22 ÷ 7) × 49

⇒ Surface area = 4 × 22 × 7

⇒ Surface area = 88 × 7 = 616 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 616 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Sphere

The volume of a sphere is given by V = (4 ÷ 3) × π × r³.

Hemisphere Surface Area

A hemisphere has a Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2 × π × r² and a Total Surface Area (TSA) = 3 × π × r².

Volume of a Hemisphere

The volume of a hemisphere is exactly half of a sphere: V = (2 ÷ 3) × π × r³.
